methodology.notes: Cortex 0.1 is a cognitive architecture from Principled Machines. A cognitive core directs the work; a language model is one kind of compute it uses, for semantic judgement, and other parts of a task go to retrieval, programs and other specialized components. We attribute the result to two mechanisms: enhanced retrieval for multi-hop questions over the knowledge base, and process-calculus abstractions for the policy workflows. Submitted as custom because Cortex replaces the standard single-model scaffold. No task-specific fine-tuning, no prompt tuning against the grader, no post-training on labels, and no autoresearch loop. Cost is the average agent spend per trajectory, excluding the user simulator. Write-up: https://principledmachines.com/research/tau3-banking/

verification.details: All 97 banking_knowledge tasks, 4 trials each, with the default user simulator (gpt-5.2). Benchmark prompts, policies, tools and evaluator unmodified.
